problemsFixed: The draft uses the phrase 'according to KIRO 7 News Seattle' in the dek and body, violating the rule to attribute claims but not present them as fact in a way that sounds like a direct quote or unsupported assertion; attribution must be precise.
The draft implies a specific date (12 November 2026) which is not explicitly stated in the source snippets, only the publication date (2026-11-12).
The draft contains filler/evaluative language in the context section ('The provided sources do not contain information explaining why...').
The structure is repetitive and lacks the required rhythm (varying sentence length and avoiding four short declarative sentences in a row).
